sites.name: Rivian pre-owned
sites.notes: Probed 2026-08-11: pages 200 but client-rendered shells with zero VIN/price; data is GraphQL under robots-disallowed /api/. Posture: no compliant data route. | 2026-09-05: REVERSED — the shop moved off the gateway. Rivian's pre-owned SPA now talks to its own React Router routes: POST /configurations/api/v1/shop/search for the list and /configurations/inventory/pre-owned/<configId>/build for the car, which server-renders the whole shopVehicle result (VIN, price, odometer, delivery centre) as a turbo-stream payload a plain polite GET reads. robots.txt's `disallow: /api/` is a prefix rule and does not reach /configurations/api/ (Rivian lists six other app /api/ subtrees by name and not the shop's); the /api/gql/* calls the page still makes are not read. Search is postalCode-scoped, caps at 30 rows, and serves two national pools — California and everywhere else (measured across 53 ZIPs; MA sells no pre-owned at all) — so the model-year facet, not geography, is what gets an answer under the cap. lib/oem/rivian.mjs enumerates both pools by model year and certifies complete. Only the lane reports this domain; it is not crawled.

sites.notes: Discovered via Common Crawl dealer-platform URL fingerprint sweep (CC-MAIN-2026-30), 2026-08-17 — site serves inventory paths matching a platform we extract | auto-promoted by probe 2026-08-17: 1 VIN vehicles on 1 page(s), platform dealeron | diagnosed 2026-08-20 from the ID. Buzz coverage audit (docs/agents/coverage-audit-2026-08-20.md), which flagged this rooftop as registered-but-still-missing: the bare apex mosesvolkswagen.com serves a TLS cert for *.dealeron.com, not itself (ERR_TLS_CERT_ALTNAME_INVALID on a direct connection) — page fetches survive because fetchPage()'s www/apex retry (lib/http.mjs) papers over it, but the DealerOn API call in lib/platforms/dealeron-api.mjs builds its URL from crawl.mjs's `origin` (crawl.mjs:110, always the bare domain) with no equivalent www fallback, so pullLot() throws on every call and the crawl falls back to the slow HTML/ItemList walk, which then bails at the NO_EV_FLOOR (0 EVs in 40 pages) before ever reaching the cars this dealer does list. Diagnosis-only, not a registry fix: switching this row's domain to www.mosesvolkswagen.com would dodge the cert but changes dealerDomain identity for every existing listing/price-history row keyed to the bare domain, which is out of scope for a registry curation pass. Confirmed independently (crawl.mjs www.mosesvolkswagen.com, not committed) that the API works fine over www and the site's full 161-vehicle inventory (94 used + 67 new, complete pull) is 100% gasoline/hybrid — zero EVs or PHEVs on the lot as of 2026-08-20, so even a fixed crawl would not find the Buzz the audit inferred here; either it already sold or the audit's WV-level inference pointed at the wrong specific rooftop.

sites.name: 712 Auto Sales
sites.notes: Albuquerque NM independent. First Overfuel site — built lib/platforms/overfuel.mjs for it 2026-08-18: SRP is an ItemList of ListItem->Product whose url (VIN in slug) + price the generic extractItemListEntries can't see, and the SRP slug (/used-cars-albuquerque-nm) is unguessable, so the lot went unenumerated. New lane seeds the SRP off the homepage, parses its Products, and follows rel=next to the front of the queue; VDPs carry generic Vehicle JSON-LD. Caught 3 EVs (Subaru Solterra, Rivian R1S, and a Lexus RZ the sitemap-only path had missed). truncated at budget; EVs ingest, delisting deferred.
